perf.note: numpy prototype, dense O(N^2) neighbour matrices; a Burst port with a spatial hash is the game's cost

locality: local: every input is the agent's own state, neighbours within its perception radius (prey 50 u, predators 80 u, in a 200 u cell), the food at its own position, and the membrane only when it is within R; all vectors in the agent's own body frame; no census, no global frame
